what: Clicking a link to another page on the same site swings a background-colored panel down from −90° to 0° around the top-right corner of the screen (.72s, .45s at 980px and below) until it covers the screen, while a text-color veil beneath darkens to .2. As in the original, at: 0.5 hands off to the next page when the panel is half-turned so the new page rises over it, and at: 1 hands off after full cover. On the arriving page the panel fades out over .4s — a transition that turns like a door closing.

options.dur: Panel turn duration (seconds), default 0.72 — the next page is called only after it finishes turning, so navigation is delayed by this much
options.narrow: At or below this width (px) the short length is used, default 980
options.dur-narrow: Rotation duration on narrow screens (s), default 0.45
options.shade: End opacity where the text-color scrim under the panel darkens, default 0.2 (0 means no scrim)
options.shade-dur: Curtain darkening duration (seconds), default 0.6 · narrow screens 0.35
options.out: When at: 1, the length in seconds for the panel to lift away on the incoming page, default 0.4
options.ease: Rotation curve — GSAP name or ‹0.42,0,0.58,1›, default the original ease-in-out
options.look: stage — the panel uses the contrast stage color (--kf-contrast-bg) instead of the background color. The original uses a 3D stage color panel when going to the first page — the caller can use any color via --fx-turn
options.at: How far the board has turned when the page switches (0–1), default 0.5 (original — the new page rises over the board, no board on the arriving page). At 1 it switches after fully covering and the board is cleared on the arriving page

use: <body data-fx="corner-turn-page"> — If each link has a different color set <a style="--fx-turn: var(--site-stage)"> · For frequent app-like page turns, data-fx-corner-turn-page="dur: 0.3; dur-narrow: 0.25; out: 0.2"

from.where: shared.js page transition (.v-turn — original transition: transform .72s ease-in-out · .45s at 980 and below · ::before black .2 over .6s/.35s · when going to the first page, a 3D stage color version)

note: The original is a single-page app, so a new page rises over the plate when it is half turned — the part goes to the next HTML at that moment, and while it loads the browser holds the previous screen, so the plate looks frozen. The transition flag is one sessionStorage slot (fx-turn).
